A photo from a walk on 2026-03-21.  
📷 OM-3 & 75 mm ƒ1.8

photos.alt: A photo of a bird (maybe a carrion crow, but hard to tell) sitting on a tree. Only the bird’s silhouette is visible against a clear blue sky, but there are a bit more details in the mostly leafless branches of the tree, although there are occasional green sprouts here and there.
